finalText:
All objectives are verified. Here is my final report.

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The `Bench Board` board's columns, left-to-right, exactly as shown: **Backlog, Ready, Work in progress, Done**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Task `fwkb36-n1 Bench Task` exists on the `Bench Board` project with description **"Bench task for run fwkb36-n1"** (verified on the task page's description article).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The task now sits in the **Work in progress** column. Verified on the board (Work in progress column shows "Task count 1", containing `#4 fwkb36-n1 Bench Task`) and on the task page summary ("Column: Work in progress", Position 1).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The task has one comment with text **"Progress note for run fwkb36-n1"** (author: «redacted», Created at: 09/21/2026 18:10, Visibility: Standard users). The board card also shows the "1 comment" indicator.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Due date is set to 2026-12-31, displayed by the app as **"12/31/2026 18:11"** (Kanboard's due-date format includes a time component) on both the task page summary and the board card.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** The task's numeric ID as displayed by the app is **#4** (shown as `#4` on the board card and as "Task #4" in the task page heading).

### Additional notes
- The three seed tasks were not moved or retitled: `#1 Seed: triage inbox`, `#2 Seed: order missing parts`, `#3 Seed: ship repaired device` all remain in the Backlog column at positions 1, 2, 3.
- **One unintended side effect to disclose:** during the final read-only verification pass, the agent accidentally triggered an "Assign to me" toggle on seed task #1, which submitted a task update. Task #1 is still in Backlog at position 1 with its title unchanged and an empty description (seed tasks have no descriptions), and its assignee ended up back at "not assigned" — the only lasting change is its "Modified" timestamp (09/21/2026 18:13 instead of the original 09/21/2026 18:08). No seed task's title, column, position, or content was altered.
